mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_comment (resource_id, root_id, parent_id, user_id, is_anonymous, display_name, avatar, reply_to_uid, reply_to_name, content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{rootId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{isAnonymous}, #{displayName}, #{avatar}, #{replyToUid}, #{replyToName}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resource_comment WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id = 0) AND status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_comment SET status = 'DELETED', content = '该评论已删除', display_name = '已删除', is_anonymous = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE resource_comment SET root_id = #{rootId} WHERE id = #{id}
